# FASTQ parser provenance

`kseq.h` is the klib FASTA/FASTQ parser by Attractive Chaos, with its original
MIT license preserved in the header. It was vendored unchanged from the local
KSSD3codex `klib/kseq.h` snapshot on 2026-11-23. The exact input file SHA256 is:

`c3dfb12a55aec52397f64fe63559839a934c1adb7b8470456ee7d76475986b66`

Upstream project: https://github.com/attractivechaos/klib

The snapshot is identified by this hash, not an asserted upstream commit.
